title: Fix 'syntopica client claude': claude mcp add swallows the server name as an env var
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

mcp_add_command builds: claude mcp add --scope user --env SYNTOPICA_DATA=... atrium -- uv run ... . Claude Code 2.1.330 treats -e/--env as variadic and consumes 'atrium', failing with 'Invalid environment variable format: atrium'. The hub prints 'client: claude mcp add failed' but still installs the skill.
Working order: claude mcp add --scope user atrium --env SYNTOPICA_DATA=<data> -- uv run --project <checkout> atrium-mcp
done_when: syntopica client claude registers atrium on current Claude Code and the readback check passes; a test pins the argv order (name before --env)
result: Fix 'syntopica client claude': claude mcp add swallows the server name as an env var
evidence: mcp_add_command puts the name before --env; tests/test_mcp_add_command.py pins the order. Against Claude Code 2.1.331 with an isolated config dir: 'Added stdio MCP server atrium', readback status 'matches'.
